title: Reward transaction audit logging with timestamp and user identifier
gherkin:
Feature: Reward Transaction Audit Logging
  Scenario: System logs reward transaction with timestamp and user identifier
    Given a reward transaction is initiated by an authorized operator
    When the reward is processed and applied to a tenant account
    Then an audit log entry is created containing:
      | Field | Requirement |
      | timestamp | ISO 8601 format |
      | user_identifier | operator ID or system account |
      | transaction_type | REWARD |
      | amount | reward amount |
      | tenant_id | affected tenant |
    And the audit log entry is immutable after creation
rationale: Core requirement from filtered abstract: 'System shall log all reward and penalty transactions with timestamp and user identifier'. E1 provides context on operator actions and RBAC. E2 establishes general audit logging requirements. This test ensures foundational audit trail for reward transactions.
usedContextItems: System shall log all reward and penalty transactions with timestamp and user identifier
